relationships.subject: diabetes
relationships.evidence_quote: PNN density was reduced in the somatosensory cortex and medial prefrontal cortex, and increased in the insular cortex, amygdala and reticular thalamic nucleus of diabetic mice

relationships.subject: perineuronal nets in insular cortex
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings suggest that diabetes switches salience attribution towards negative values and this is causally related to increases in PNNs in the insular cortex.

key_findings: PNN density rises in insular cortex of diabetic mice but falls in somatosensory and medial prefrontal cortex
Enzymatic PNN degradation in insula corrected social interaction and place escape/avoidance abnormalities without changing mechanical thresholds
